segments.name: Short drama streaming
segments.description: Operates FlexTV, a short drama streaming platform offering original and licensed dramas to users across many regions.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and manages its business as a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Users pay for membership and top-up streaming services, and customers pay for online advertising services and content licensing.
revenueModel.evidence: Yuder also acquires third party content licenses which it then translates and distributes on its FlexTV platform.
